footnote_text: The Class B ordinary shares are held indirectly by Eastwave Family Limited, a British Virgin Islands company wholly owned by a trust established for the benefit of the Reporting Person and her family. The Reporting Person is the settlor of the trust.

The number of Class B ordinary shares has been retrospectively adjusted to reflect the change in the ADS ratio and the 240-to-1 reverse share split effective July 16, 2026. || This transaction involved a transfer of 59,198 Class B ordinary shares from Eastwave Family Limited to the Reporting Person directly. This transaction effected only a change in the form of beneficial ownership from indirect to direct, without any change in the Reporting Person's pecuniary interest in the shares, and is exempt pursuant to Rule 16a-13 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
